post.description:

post.description:
You know the congress, session and roll call number (for example from `votes` or from a clerk.house.gov/Votes/{year}{roll} URL) and want the full result with member positions. Use `member_vote` for a single member.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

congress.description:
Congress number (101 = 1989-1990, 119 = 2025-2026). Required unless `url` is given.

Provider reference: minimum 101; maximum 200.

party.description:
Keep only members of this party as coded by the Clerk (D, R, I).

Provider reference: allowed values ["D", "R", "I"].

position.description:
Keep only members who voted this way. Yea-and-nay votes use Yea/Nay; recorded votes use Aye/No; the value is matched exactly as the Clerk records it.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Yea", "Nay", "Aye", "No", "Present", "Not Voting"].

roll.description:
Roll call number within the session. Required unless `url` is given.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 9999.

session.description:
Session of the congress: 1 (odd year) or 2 (even year). Required unless `url` is given.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 2.

state.description: Keep only members from this two-letter state or territory postal code (e.g. NY). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

url.description: Alternative to congress/session/roll: a clerk.house.gov vote URL such as https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2025145 or https://clerk.house.gov/evs/2025/roll145.xml ({year}{roll} or {year}/roll{roll}).

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One House roll call vote by congress, session and roll call number: question, legislation, type, result, date and time, totals by party and overall, and each member's recorded position keyed by Bioguide ID (optionally filtered by state, party or position). Read from the Clerk's roll call XML at /evs/{year}/roll{nnn}.xml; the year is derived from congress and session and cross-checked against the document.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `amendment_author` | string |  |
| `amendment_num` | string |  |
| `bill_number` | string | Compact bill number (HR1, HJRES25, S2403) as accepted by the `votes` bill filter; null when legis_num is not a bill. |
| `chamber` | string |  |
| `congress` | number |  |
| `date` | string | Vote date (Eastern time) as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `date_text` | string | Date as the Clerk prints it (e.g. 22-May-2025). |
| `description` | string | Vote description / bill title; null when the Clerk left it empty. |
| `filters` | object |  |
| `legis_num` | string | Legislation as printed in the XML (e.g. H R 1, H J RES 25); null for votes without legislation (quorum calls, elections). |
| `majority` | string | Majority party code at the time of the vote (R or D) when the document carries it. |
| `member_count` | number | Number of recorded positions in the document before filtering. |
| `members` | object[] | Recorded positions (after the optional filters), in the Clerk's order (alphabetical by sort name). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_url` | string | The human-readable vote page, https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/{vote_id}. |
| `question` | string |  |
| `result` | string | Passed, Failed, Agreed to, ... as printed. |
| `returned_count` | number |  |
| `roll` | number |  |
| `session` | number |  |
| `source_url` | string | The roll call XML that was read. |
| `time` | string | Vote time as printed (e.g. 6:54 AM), Eastern time. |
| `time_etz` | string | 24-hour Eastern time (HH:MM) from the document's time-etz attribute. |
| `totals` | object |  |
| `totals_by_party` | object[] |  |
| `vote_id` | string | {year}{roll:03}, the id in clerk.house.gov/Votes/{vote_id}. |
| `vote_type` | string | YEA-AND-NAY, RECORDED VOTE, 2/3 YEA-AND-NAY, QUORUM, ... as printed. |
| `year` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Finding roll call numbers (to pass to `vote` or `member_vote`) for a bill, a date range or a session; browsing what the House voted on.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

bill.description: Only votes on bills whose number starts with this: HR1, H.R. 1, HJRES25, S2403, HRES212, HCONRES14 (spaces and dots are ignored). Prefix match on the Clerk's side: HR1 also matches HR1366.

congress.description:
Congress number; the listing covers the 101st Congress onwards.

Provider reference: minimum 101; maximum 200.

page.description:
Page of 10 results, 1 by default. The output's continuation cursor is the next page number.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000.

roll.description:
Only this roll call number.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 9999.

vote_type.description:
vote_type

Provider reference: allowed values ["Yea-And-Nay", "Recorded Vote", "2/3 Yea-And-Nay", "2/3 Recorded Vote", "3/5 Yea-And-Nay", "3/5 Recorded Vote", "Quorum"].

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
List House roll call votes of a congress and session, newest first, 10 per page, optionally filtered by roll call number, bill number or vote type. The bill filter is the Clerk's own prefix match: HR1 also lists HR1366, HR1676 and every other bill whose number starts with 1; pair it with `roll` or filter the rows client-side for an exact bill. Each entry carries the roll call number, date and time, legislation, question, description, vote type, result and the yea/nay/present/not-voting tally. Read from the Clerk's /Votes/MemberVotes listing partial.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `congress` | number |  |
| `filters` | object |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `session` | number |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_results` | number | Total matching votes as the listing header states ('x - y of N Results'). |
| `votes` | object[] |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

votes.description: Do No Harm in Medicaid Act
votes.question: On Passage

votes.description: Do No Harm in Medicaid Act
votes.question: On Motion to Recommit
